title: Kit checks refuse when there is nothing to measure
requirement: The three kit checks must fail, with a named reason, when their input is empty or broken: context-budget without a session store or session log, schema-lint with no tool matched or no preset parsed, check-portability with an inventory that declares no plugin rows or a mounted row that exists only as a comment. Each run also records its own negative control in its output.
reason: The three checks are command-line programs run by make verify; they print a human table, not the CASE_SUMMARY JSON a case_run driver must emit, and the negative control they carry is their own output line rather than a CASE_NEGATIVE_CONTROL run. The behaviour is verified by running them and quoting exit codes (see the task note).
steps: cd /home/iustimov/dsh-kit && make verify  -> exit 0, and the output carries 'negative control: 2 empty/broken input(s) refused, a healthy input accepted' (schema-lint) and 'negative control: 4 empty/broken input(s) refused, a healthy input accepted' (context-budget), plus check-portability PASS for negative-control:empty-and-commented-inputs-refuse
node scripts/context-budget.mjs --sessions /tmp/no-such-store -> exit 1 with 'refused: no session store at /tmp/no-such-store: ...'
echo '{}' > /tmp/empty-budgets.json && node scripts/context-budget.mjs --budgets /tmp/empty-budgets.json -> exit 1 with 'refused: the budget table in ... is empty'
comment out a mounted row in profile/cordis.patch.yml on a scratch copy of the kit and run scripts/check-portability.mjs -> inventory:matches-disk FAIL naming the row
replace plugins/inventory.json with an empty plugin list and remove the tarballs on a scratch copy -> inventory:matches-disk FAIL with 'declares no plugin rows'
expected: Every empty or broken input is refused with exit 1 and a reason that names the file or directory, and every run prints its negative-control line so a green run shows the control was exercised. A healthy run stays exit 0.
